turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
menu
How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders are typically processed and shipped within 1 to 3 business days (Monday through Friday).
Once your package ships, you will receive an email with your tracking number! Express orders placed before 1:00 PM CST ship the same business day, while orders placed after 1:00 PM CST or on weekends/holidays ship the next business day.
If you'd like me to look up your order status, just share your order number and email address!

How do I find my tracking link?
Once your order ships, you will automatically receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking link and tracking number.
If you have already received that email, simply click the tracking link inside to view real-time updates from the carrier.
If you haven't received a shipping email yet, please share your order number and email address, and I can check your order status for you!

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
Here to help you shop
menu
Once a package has already been shipped, we are unfortunately unable to change or reroute the delivery address directly.
If your order is still in transit, you can try reaching out directly to the shipping carrier (such as USPS, FedEx, or UPS) using your tracking number to request a package intercept or address modification.
